items.name: Deployment Standards
items.description: Blue-green or canary deployments; feature flags for gradual rollout; instant rollback capability

items.name: Environment Parity
items.description: Dev/Test/Prod environments consistent; IaC for all environments; config externalized

items.name: Pipeline Standards
items.description: All repos have CI pipeline; builds <15 min; deployment to dev automated on merge
fragments: deployment to dev automated on merge

items.name: Quality Gates
items.description: Build fails on: test failure, coverage drop, security findings (High+), lint errors
fragments: Build fails on: test failure, coverage drop, security findings (High+), lint errors

items.name: Code Comments
items.description: Self-documenting code preferred; complex logic commented; no commented-out code in main branch
fragments: no commented-out code in main branch

items.name: Code Complexity
items.description: Cyclomatic complexity <10; method length <50 lines; class length <500 lines; SonarQube gates enforced

items.name: Coding Standards
items.description: Language-specific style guides enforced via linters; consistent formatting via Prettier/Black
fragments: Language-specific style guides enforced via linters

items.name: Technical Debt
items.description: Tech debt tagged in backlog; addressed within 2 sprints; debt ratio <15% of velocity

items.name: PR Review SLA
items.description: PRs reviewed within 4 hours; no PR open >48 hours without action
fragments: no PR open >48 hours without action

items.name: Pair Programming
items.description: Complex features require pairing; knowledge sharing sessions weekly

items.name: Review Checklist
items.description: Functionality, tests, security, performance, maintainability checked; constructive feedback
fragments: Functionality, tests, security, performance, maintainability checked

items.name: API Documentation
items.description: OpenAPI spec auto-generated; examples provided; changelog maintained

items.name: Architecture Docs
items.description: ADRs for decisions; C4 diagrams maintained; onboarding guide for new developers

items.name: README Standards
items.description: Every repo has README: purpose, setup, run, test, deploy instructions; kept current
fragments: Every repo has README: purpose, setup, run, test, deploy instructions

items.name: Alerting Standards
items.description: Alerts actionable; runbook linked; on-call rotation; alert fatigue monitored

items.name: Logging Standards
items.description: Structured JSON logging; correlation IDs; no PII in logs; log levels appropriate

items.name: Metrics & Tracing
items.description: RED metrics (Rate, Errors, Duration); distributed tracing enabled; dashboards per service

items.name: Integration Testing
items.description: Contract tests for APIs; integration tests for external dependencies; test data management

items.name: Performance Testing
items.description: Load tests before production; baseline established; regression detected automatically

items.name: Test Automation
items.description: All regression automated; manual testing for exploratory only; test pyramid observed

items.name: Unit Test Coverage
items.description: Minimum 80% line coverage; 90% for critical paths; no untested public methods

items.name: Branch Protection
items.description: PR required for main/develop; 2 approvers; CI must pass; no force push

items.name: Branching Strategy
items.description: GitFlow or trunk-based; feature branches <3 days; no direct commits to main/master

items.name: Commit Standards
items.description: Conventional commits format; atomic commits; meaningful messages; linked to work item
